# Suites

> Suites is a unit testing framework for TypeScript backends working with inversion of control and dependency injection. It generates mocks for class dependencies and provides a flat test container that constructs classes without bootstrapping your application framework, so you can write solitary or sociable unit tests with minimal boilerplate.

Suites supports NestJS 10/11/12 and Inversify 7/8, plus InjectionJS ^2.6.1 starting in Suites 4.1. It integrates with Jest and Vitest and offers migration guides from Automock and Suites 3. Node.js requirements: ^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || ^26.0.0. CommonJS and ESM are supported. InjectionJS supports constructor injection, not contextual inject() calls or production provider/container configuration.

## Get started

- [Get Started overview](https://suites.dev/docs/get-started/): entry point for new users
- [Why Suites](https://suites.dev/docs/get-started/why-suites): the problem Suites solves and how it differs from manual mocking
- [Installation](https://suites.dev/docs/get-started/installation): install the right packages for your DI framework and test runner
- [Quickstart](https://suites.dev/docs/get-started/quickstart): a minimal end-to-end example

## Guides

- [Guides overview](https://suites.dev/docs/guides/): index of conceptual and how-to guides
- [Fundamentals](https://suites.dev/docs/guides/fundamentals): core concepts and the testing model
- [Solitary tests](https://suites.dev/docs/guides/solitary): isolating a single class with auto-generated mocks
- [Sociable tests](https://suites.dev/docs/guides/sociable): testing a class together with selected real collaborators
- [NestJS](https://suites.dev/docs/guides/nestjs/): service tests, custom injection tokens, and selected real collaborators
- [InversifyJS](https://suites.dev/docs/guides/inversify/): symbol tokens, named lookups, and sociable tests
- [InjectionJS](https://suites.dev/docs/guides/injectionjs/): constructor injection, InjectionToken overrides, Vitest module identity, and support boundaries
- [Test doubles](https://suites.dev/docs/guides/test-doubles): mocks, stubs, and spies in Suites
- [How Suites works](https://suites.dev/docs/guides/how-suites-works/): how Suites builds an isolated DI graph for each test
